rules.statement: If a judgment-debtor has changed their place of residence and this change is not communicated to the Court, it suffices for the Fiscal's Officer to go to the place of residence mentioned in the plaint or answer.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am, therefore, of opinion that, in the absence of any information given to the Court of a change of residence, it would be sufficient compliance with the terms of the section if the Fiscal's Officer went to the place of residence mentioned by the debtor in the plaint or answer."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 226 of the Civil Procedure Code
